records.text: Owens said an unnamed source involved in planning told her Turning Point USA insisted on an outdoor event despite the difficulty of checking tickets.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And you are correct. I've expressed this before. My source was solid on the fact that Turning Point USA insisted on being outdoor despite them advising that there was no traffic control, meaning that we wouldn't be able to look at people's tickets. That is now stunning, given the text messages that Turning Point USA purports to be real.
